lines.zh: 我拖着身子，在荒地上慢慢挪。
lines.en: I drag my body slowly across the waste.

lines.zh: 每一步，喉咙里都咕噜一声。
lines.en: Every step pulls a gurgle from my throat.

lines.zh: 末地石很硬，磨得我发疼。
lines.en: The end stone is hard and grinds against me.

lines.zh: 我朝高地那边爬。
lines.en: I crawl toward the highlands over there.

lines.zh: 地上留下一条湿痕。
lines.en: A wet trail is left behind me.

lines.zh: 我走一路，吐一路小东西。
lines.en: I walk along spitting little things the whole way.

lines.zh: 风把沙子吹进我的褶子里。
lines.en: The wind blows sand into my folds.

lines.zh: 我绕过裂缝，那边太深。
lines.en: I go around the chasm; it's too deep.

lines.zh: 中部群系的石头更软一些。
lines.en: The stones in the middle biomes feel softer.

lines.zh: 我挪得很慢，但一直在动。
lines.en: Slow as I am, I keep dragging myself on.

lines.zh: 有东西卡在我喉咙里，我咳了一下。
lines.en: Something's stuck in my throat, so I cough.

lines.zh: 我停下来，先吐一口。
lines.en: I stop and spit something out first.

lines.zh: 咕噜……咕噜……没人听得见。
lines.en: Gurgle, gurgle, and nobody hears it.

lines.zh: 我蹲着，把吐出来的东西又咽回去。
lines.en: I crouch and swallow back what I spat out.

lines.zh: 我身上在冒小泡。
lines.en: Little bubbles keep rising on my skin.

lines.zh: 我吐出一颗石子，滚了两格。
lines.en: I spit out a pebble and it rolls two blocks.

lines.zh: 没人来，我就一直咕噜。
lines.en: No one comes, so I just keep gurgling.

lines.zh: 我把身子摊开，像一滩水。
lines.en: I spread myself out flat like a puddle.

lines.zh: 喉咙里那个东西还在动。
lines.en: The thing in my throat is still moving.

lines.zh: 我试着吞下空气，打了个嗝。
lines.en: I try swallowing air and give a belch.

lines.zh: 荒地很安静，只有我的声音。
lines.en: The waste is quiet except for my noise.

lines.zh: 我吐出一小截骨头，看了看。
lines.en: I spit out a small bone and look at it.

lines.zh: 我在等肚子空下来。
lines.en: I am waiting for my belly to empty.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖皮，粘液甩出去。
lines.en: I shake my hide and slime flies off.

lines.zh: 你站在那儿，我咕噜了一声。
lines.en: You stand there and I gurgle once.

lines.zh: 我抬头，喉咙开始鼓。
lines.en: I look up and my throat starts to swell.

lines.zh: 你要不要看看我吐出来的东西？
lines.en: Would you like to see what I can spit?

lines.zh: 我盯着你，慢慢张开嘴。
lines.en: I stare at you and slowly open my mouth.

lines.zh: 你的靴子上沾了末地石粉。
lines.en: Your boots are dusted with end stone powder.

lines.zh: 我歪着身子，像在听你说话。
lines.en: I lean sideways as if listening to you.

lines.zh: 我这对眼窝里没有眼皮。
lines.en: I never blink, because I have no eyelids.

lines.zh: 你走近一步，我就鼓一下。
lines.en: Take one step nearer and I swell once.

lines.zh: 你盔甲的铁味我记住了。
lines.en: Your armor's iron smell is in my memory.

lines.zh: 我在想，你能不能吃。
lines.en: I am wondering whether you can be eaten.

lines.zh: 你退后了，我就不鼓了。
lines.en: You step back, so I stop swelling.

lines.zh: 我把头偏向你，咕噜得更响。
lines.en: I turn my head your way and gurgle louder.

lines.zh: 你手里那样东西，我想吐回去。
lines.en: That thing in your hand, I want to spit back.

lines.zh: 我看了你很久，才吐出一口气。
lines.en: I watch you a long time before spitting once.

lines.zh: 我吐出一口，颜色不对。
lines.en: I spit, and the color is wrong.

lines.zh: 破了，我漏了。
lines.en: Something tore, and I'm leaking.

lines.zh: 我咕噜得很短，像噎住。
lines.en: My gurgle is short, like I'm choking.

lines.zh: 我缩成一小团，粘液都收了。
lines.en: I shrink small and pull my slime in.

lines.zh: 半边身子被砸得摊开了。
lines.en: Half of my body is splattered open.

lines.zh: 我往回爬，留下一路湿痕。
lines.en: I crawl back, leaving a wet trail.

lines.zh: 疼，我肚子里的东西在乱撞。
lines.en: It hurts; the things inside me thrash.

lines.zh: 我不敢再鼓了。
lines.en: I don't dare swell up again.

lines.zh: 我贴在地上，尽量变薄。
lines.en: I flatten against the ground as thin as I can.

lines.zh: 我又吐了一口，这次是红的。
lines.en: I spit again, and this time it's red.

lines.zh: 你手里那玩意儿我不吞。
lines.en: That thing in your hand, I won't swallow.

lines.zh: 你晃它也没用，我只吐不吞。
lines.en: Waving it won't help; I spit, not swallow.

lines.zh: 那味道让我喉咙发紧。
lines.en: That smell tightens my throat.

lines.zh: 你放下吧，我过去看看。
lines.en: Put it down and I'll come look.

lines.zh: 我朝那东西挪了一步。
lines.en: I shift one step toward that thing.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，可不是为了吃。
lines.en: I open my mouth, but not to eat.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西会响，我不喜欢。
lines.en: The thing in your hand rattles and I dislike it.

lines.zh: 我咕噜一声，算回答你了。
lines.en: I gurgle once, and that is my answer.

lines.zh: 我凑近闻了闻，又退开。
lines.en: I lean in to sniff, then pull away.

lines.zh: 这个我吞不下，太硬了。
lines.en: I can't swallow this; it's too hard.

lines.zh: 我被撞得一晃，吐了一口。
lines.en: The bump shakes me and I spit once.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的边了，软软的。
lines.en: You stepped on my edge, all soft and wet.

lines.zh: 我贴着你腿滑过去。
lines.en: I slide past against your leg.

lines.zh: 抱歉，我走得慢，挡路了。
lines.en: Sorry, I move slowly and block the way.

lines.zh: 我整个身子被挤扁又鼓回来。
lines.en: My whole body squashes flat and swells back.

lines.zh: 别推，我肚子里有东西。
lines.en: Don't push, I have things inside me.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我咕噜了一声。
lines.en: We bump together and I gurgle once.

lines.zh: 我往旁边让，让得很费劲。
lines.en: I shift aside, and it takes real effort.

lines.zh: 你脚上有我的粘液了。
lines.en: Now your foot has my slime on it.

lines.zh: 我粘在你鞋底，走了两步才掉。
lines.en: I stick to your sole and drop after two steps.

lines.zh: 你也咕噜？声调不太一样。
lines.en: You gurgle too? The pitch is different.

lines.zh: 我们并排蹲着，谁也不动。
lines.en: We crouch side by side, neither moving.

lines.zh: 我把吐出来的分你一半。
lines.en: I split what I spat out with you.

lines.zh: 你身上的泡比我多。
lines.en: You have more bubbles on you than I do.

lines.zh: 一起吐，声音会大一些。
lines.en: Spitting together makes a louder sound.

lines.zh: 你那边荒地空吗？
lines.en: Is the waste on your side empty?

lines.zh: 我们靠在一起，暖一点。
lines.en: Leaning together, we are a bit warmer.

lines.zh: 你吞回去的样子真难看。
lines.en: You look awful swallowing things back down.

lines.zh: 别抢我喉咙里那个。
lines.en: Don't take the one in my throat.

lines.zh: 明早还在这儿见？
lines.en: Shall we meet here again in the morning?

lines.zh: 我把它含进嘴里，又吐出来。
lines.en: I take it into my mouth and spit it out.

lines.zh: 这东西我收着，反正不占地方。
lines.en: I'll keep this; it takes up no space.

lines.zh: 我吸住它，拖了两格。
lines.en: I suck it up and drag it two blocks.

lines.zh: 亮亮的小块，我留着玩。
lines.en: A bright little piece, I'll keep it to play.

lines.zh: 我吐出来看看，再吞回去。
lines.en: I spit it out to look, then swallow it.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的，我都收。
lines.en: Whatever falls on the ground, I collect.

lines.zh: 这块太硬，我吐了三次。
lines.en: This one's too hard; I spat it out three times.

lines.zh: 我把它推进褶子里藏好。
lines.en: I push it into a fold to hide it.

lines.zh: 我给你带了一个，接住。
lines.en: I brought you one, so catch it.

lines.zh: 我捡的东西都带粘液。
lines.en: Everything I pick up comes with slime.

lines.zh: 那边有东西在动，我听见了。
lines.en: Something moves over there and I hear it.

lines.zh: 我喉咙开始鼓起来。
lines.en: My throat begins to swell up.

lines.zh: 有个影子从高地那边下来。
lines.en: A shadow comes down from the highlands.

lines.zh: 气味淡得几乎没有，我嗅到了。
lines.en: The scent is nearly nothing, yet I caught it.

lines.zh: 我停下咕噜，先听。
lines.en: I stop gurgling and listen first.

lines.zh: 石头后面有脚步声。
lines.en: There are footsteps behind the stone.

lines.zh: 我转头，慢慢对准那个方向。
lines.en: I turn my head and slowly aim that way.

lines.zh: 它在裂缝边上，正好。
lines.en: It's by the chasm edge, which is perfect.

lines.zh: 我肚子里的东西开始翻。
lines.en: The things in my belly start to churn.

lines.zh: 我盯住了，不动了。
lines.en: I lock on and go completely still.

lines.zh: 有活物靠近我的荒地。
lines.en: Something living is nearing my waste.

lines.zh: 这一口，我留了很久。
lines.en: I have saved this spit for a long time.

lines.zh: 咕噜，咕噜，越来越响。
lines.en: Gurgle, gurgle, louder and louder it grows.

lines.zh: 我一点一点挪过去。
lines.en: I inch my way over bit by bit.

lines.zh: 它把脸转开了，正好。
lines.en: It turned its face away, which suits me.

lines.zh: 我把自己摊平贴住地面。
lines.en: I flatten myself out against the ground.

lines.zh: 再近一点，我就能吐到。
lines.en: A little closer and I can spit that far.

lines.zh: 我停下来，等它转身。
lines.en: I stop and wait for it to turn.

lines.zh: 我的喉咙鼓到发疼。
lines.en: My throat swells until it hurts.

lines.zh: 它往左走了，我跟着转。
lines.en: It moves left, and I turn to follow.

lines.zh: 地上那条湿痕暴露了我。
lines.en: The wet trail on the ground gives me away.

lines.zh: 我等得起，荒地不会跑。
lines.en: I can wait; the waste won't run off.

lines.zh: 它听见了，我不动了。
lines.en: It heard me, so I stop moving.

lines.zh: 这个距离，正好吐得到。
lines.en: From here, my spit will reach it.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，慢慢对准。
lines.en: I open my mouth and take slow aim.

lines.zh: 我把肚子里的东西全吐出去。
lines.en: I spit everything in my belly straight out.

lines.zh: 一口粘液糊在它脸上。
lines.en: A mouthful of slime covers its face.

lines.zh: 我用身体撞过去，软但很重。
lines.en: I slam my body in, soft but heavy.

lines.zh: 它被粘住，动得慢了。
lines.en: It sticks and its movements slow down.

lines.zh: 我咬下去，牙不多，但很紧。
lines.en: I bite, few teeth but a very tight grip.

lines.zh: 我吐出一块石头，正中它。
lines.en: I spit out a stone and hit it square.

lines.zh: 它打我，我就鼓起来弹回去。
lines.en: When it hits me, I swell and bounce back.

lines.zh: 我缠住它的腿，越缠越紧。
lines.en: I wrap its legs and pull tighter and tighter.

lines.zh: 这一口我攒了整整一天。
lines.en: I have saved this mouthful for a whole day.

lines.zh: 我把它往裂缝那边推。
lines.en: I shove it toward the chasm.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里那根东西，扎出去了。
lines.en: The thing in my throat shoots out and stabs.

lines.zh: 打完我又咕噜了一声。
lines.en: When it's over, I gurgle once more.

lines.zh: 我从末地石缝里渗出来。
lines.en: I seep out of a crack in the end stone.

lines.zh: 第一声，就是咕噜。
lines.en: The first sound I make is a gurgle.

lines.zh: 荒地很空，正合我意。
lines.en: The waste is empty, exactly as I like.

lines.zh: 我在地上摊成一小片。
lines.en: I spread out into a small patch.

lines.zh: 高地的风把我吹得发凉。
lines.en: The highland wind leaves me cold.

lines.zh: 我一睁眼就开始吐。
lines.en: I start spitting the moment I open.

lines.zh: 这地方没人抢，我留下了。
lines.en: Nobody contests this place, so I stay.

lines.zh: 我从石头底下慢慢鼓起来。
lines.en: I slowly swell up from under the stone.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有别的咕噜声。
lines.en: I hear other gurgles somewhere far off.

lines.zh: 中部群系的土，味道很干。
lines.en: The soil of the middle biomes tastes dry.

lines.zh: 我把自己团成一颗球。
lines.en: I ball myself up into one lump.

lines.zh: 我出生时，嘴里就含着东西。
lines.en: When I was born, my mouth held something.

lines.zh: 天很暗，我不用眼睛。
lines.en: The sky is dark, and I need no eyes.

lines.zh: 火烤过来，我的褶子全缩了。
lines.en: The flames come and all my folds shrivel.

lines.zh: 我从高地上掉下去，摔成一滩。
lines.en: I fall from the highlands and land as a puddle.

lines.zh: 水把我泡开了，我快散了。
lines.en: Water soaks me loose and I'm coming apart.

lines.zh: 炸得我半边身子飞到石头上。
lines.en: The blast throws half of me onto the stone.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉进我肚子里。
lines.en: An arrow buries itself in my belly.

lines.zh: 紫雾钻进我的褶子，很冷。
lines.en: Violet mist crawls into my folds, cold and sharp.

lines.zh: 肚子里空了，我只能吐空气。
lines.en: My belly is empty, so I can only spit air.

lines.zh: 雷落在我旁边，我整个亮了。
lines.en: Lightning lands beside me and I light up.

lines.zh: 裂缝下面没有底，我掉进去了。
lines.en: The chasm has no bottom, and I fall in.
